answer: One bond per hardware root, 500 POA, so a single machine cannot back forty identities no matter how many labels it mints, and that bond burns outright when any recruit it sponsored fails an audit. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, which kills the replay before grading instead of after. The lotus rate stays under the bond yield. A forge of 1,000 clones needs 1,000 roots and 1,000 bonds, and the trellis of sponsorships unwinds at the first burn.
